lane: orch1 review: performance, stability and shipping (senior tech lead, fresh eyes)
head: f3ee3a036
verdict: Under par (7.5). There is no crash blocker. The engine-side engineering is better than most web games: budgets are gated, context loss recovers, the sim is deterministic, the post-chain leak is fixed, and e2e has 0 console errors. The shipping layer is below what a top-tier live game ships with. The CDN never returns a 304, and it marks the hashed JS no-store, so a returning player downloads everything again. There is no crash or performance telemetry. No real-time frame gate has ever passed validly. The game runs with 0 of 40 shader-program headroom and 208 MB of RIFT memory margin. It has only been tested on one Apple M5 in Chrome. A touch device or a browser without WebGL2 gets a menu that cannot play.

verifiedClaims.claim: Portal SEO 404 on /games/vale needs a portal rebuild
verifiedClaims.result: STALE. https://forgeflowgames.com/games/vale returns 308 to /games/vale/, which returns 200 with title 'Play VALE Free Online | ForgeFlow Games', a meta description and og:image cover.jpg?v=dd8aebd3. The sitemap lists vale. No rebuild is needed.

STALE. The idle gates run (3633bdf90) has seed 11 at 445k. The worst is seed 23 at 483k (17k margin). The triangle governor (crowd.ts:356-362, renderer.ts) absorbs spikes by dropping detail. Only RIFT at High is gated (see TECH-04).
FIXED. Menu GPU growth across 4 rebuilds is -0.8 % (idle_gates.json perf_1080_prod_counts).

PRESENT. renderer.ts:348-349 and 1360-1400 plus sky.ts:37 rebuild the VFX atlas, PMREM, bitmaps and programs. The HUD ViewPlate (hud/world.tsx:199) shows 'Restoring the view'. probe_ctxloss.mjs last passed 2026-10-29 (ok>lost>restoring>ok, 409 ms), but it is not in any standing gate.

strengths: Hard budgets are enforced by a harness, not by hope. perf_1080 --prod gates tris, draws and programs, and also programs first seen after 1:00. Its latest run reads 455k/445k/483k tris, 280-295 draws, 0 late programs, and GATE PASS.
A runtime triangle governor (crowd.ts:356-362, lod.ts:48) lowers crowd ink, shadows and flashes in crowded frames, so a worst-case teamfight degrades without blowing the budget.

The sim is deterministic by construction. dmath.ts replaces the implementation-defined Math.sin/cos/atan2/hypot, src/sim has no Math.random and no clocks, and probe_sim_determinism checks digest and order independence. Lockstep sends a state digest every ~2 s for desync detection (net.ts:8, lockstep_host.ts:170).
WebGL context loss is handled end to end: an abandoned GPU timer, bitmap restore, parallel program re-warm and a player-facing 'Restoring the view' plate.

Dynamic resolution only steps down for GPU-bound frames. It probes back up, distrusts the ANGLE-Metal timer and handles vsync drift (quality.ts header). This is a better design than most shipped web titles have.

The profile store is robust to private mode and corrupt blobs. It wraps every access in try/catch, falls back to memory, copies a corrupt blob to .corrupt, runs schema migrations and refuses a profile from a future client (profile_store.ts:1-26, 230-275).

The deploy packager verifies before it ships: manifest sha256, every asset ref, the Opus/m4a fallback map, no source maps, third-party notices and only referenced assets staged (tools/package_deploy.ts). Content is content-addressed and the manifest is fetched with cache: 'no-cache' (boot/catalog.ts:107).

Startup is fast on a warm host. FCP is 77-89 ms and LCP 432-620 ms. The cold Home is 28 requests and 5.8 MB, and a warm reload reaches Home in about 200 ms. The map and models warm during the draft (ui/state.ts:298-317), so loading-to-HUD is about 3.1 s locally.
There are 0 console warnings or errors in any of the 11 UX phases (orch1 ux notes.md), 57/57 node probes pass, and a 680-game bot soak shows 0 bot faults.
Match memory would pass (RIFT 2792, BRIDGE 2460, Home ≤1304 MB of 3000/2500) and menu GPU memory is flat across rebuilds.

improvements.what: Fix VALE's CDN caching: honour If-None-Match with 304, make content-addressed files immutable, and stop sending no-store for hashed JS
improvements.why: Verified live with curl. assets/index-NSSwHBt2.js is served 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private', so every visit downloads about 0.8 MB br of JS again (3 MB raw over 5 chunks). catalog/assets/<12-hex>-*.webp/glb are only 'max-age=86400'. A request with a matching If-None-Match returns 200 with the full body, not 304 (workers/games-cdn/src/index.js has no conditional handling). So after 24 h a returning player downloads all ~55 MB of match assets again (orch1 ux: 250 requests, 54.7-57.7 MB by the first match frame). VALE is not in IMMUTABLE_HASHED_GAMES (index.js:87).
improvements.how: In workers/games-cdn/src/index.js: (1) add 'vale' to IMMUTABLE_HASHED_GAMES. (2) Add an immutable rule for /vale/catalog/assets/<12hex>-* and /vale/catalog/schema-N/<version>/*. (3) Give manifest.json, config.js and game_controls.js 'no-cache' with an ETag. (4) Answer If-None-Match against object.httpEtag with 304. Verify by curl before and after on a preview worker. Deploying needs the owner's release go-ahead (Cloudflare freeze).
improvements.risk: This is a shared worker for every game. Keep the change opt-in per game and keep a 304 path test. Do not deploy before the release go-ahead.

improvements.what: Add privacy-respecting crash, performance and funnel telemetry, plus a build stamp
improvements.why: src has no window.onerror and no unhandledrejection handler (grep: 0 hits). It has no beacon and no build id. Every reading so far comes from one Apple M5 in Chrome. Windows/D3D11, Intel and AMD iGPUs and Safari users are blind spots, and no one can tell whether the calibration picks the right tier for real players or where players drop out between load, draft, match and end. The portal's Report Bug button (game_controls.js:173-187) shows 'Bug reporting not available on this game' because VALE never defines window.__AUDIT__. That is a dead control on screen.
improvements.how: Design a minimal anonymous schema with no PII and an opt-out in Settings. Send events through navigator.sendBeacon: boot (GPU renderer string from WEBGL_debug_renderer_info, tier picked, DPR, catalog version, git-hash build id injected by vite define), funnel stages, per-match fps buckets, dynres floor time, ctx-loss count and peak JS heap, and errors (deduped message plus stack hash). Point it at a small worker endpoint modelled on workers/dyefield-net. Wire window.__AUDIT__.reportBug to the same endpoint with the build id and the last 50 console lines. Show the build id on the Profile footer next to the content version (profile.tsx:32). The endpoint deploy waits for the release go-ahead, so ship the client side behind a config.js URL (null = off).
improvements.risk: Privacy: keep it anonymous and get the owner's ruling on the opt-out default (record it in owner_rulings).

improvements.what: Get one valid idle real-time match run, and make the quiet-window precondition mechanical
improvements.why: Rulings 20/27/28 need realtime_match ≥ 99 % of seconds at 58+. It has never passed validly. It was not measured 3 times in max2 and again in orch1 (57.6 %, worst second 32 frames, a 25 s stall at 993-1024 s while the owner's Chrome GPU helper used 27-29 % CPU). High frame timing (57.1 fps, 29 dropped) and match memory have the same status. Until one valid run exists, nobody can claim 60 fps on High at 1080p.
improvements.how: Add a --require-quiet precheck to perf_1080 and probe_match_memory. It refuses to start, and polls in the background for up to N hours, while any non-harness Google Chrome GPU process uses more than 5 % CPU, the 1-minute load is 2.5 or higher, or a heavy slot is held. Then queue both gates through heavy.py in a late-night window, or ask the owner to close Chrome for 40 minutes. Record the result in idle_gates.json.
improvements.risk: None to the game. Never kill the owner's Chrome; only wait for it.

improvements.what: Extend the budget gate to BRIDGE, FRAY, the Ultra and Low tiers, and more RIFT seeds
improvements.why: perf_1080's matchPeak always opens render_bench.html?mode=rift&q=high (perf_1080.mjs:621). The 500k/450/40 budgets have never been gated on FRAY (ten fighters on one plate, the densest crowd), on BRIDGE (one lane, ten fighters plus all waves) or on Ultra (DPR ≤ 2, 4096² shadows, more shadow-caster draws). Three RIFT seeds spread 445-483k, so the true RIFT tail is not known either.
improvements.how: Add --match-modes rift,bridge,fray and --match-q high,ultra to matchPeak, reuse the existing peak/overBudget logic, and add RIFT seeds 3 and 21. Gate on the max across all of them. Run once through heavy.py and record per-mode peaks in idle_gates.json. If FRAY or BRIDGE breaks 500k, hand the case to TECH-06.
improvements.risk: Longer gate (about +25 min). Keep the default prod run to 3 seeds × 3 modes.

improvements.what: Buy back shader-program headroom: 40 of 40 used on every seed
improvements.why: Programs peak at exactly 40 on seeds 7, 11 and 23 (idle_gates.json). A context restore went 38 to 40 on 2026-10-29. Any new material variant (a skin effect, a new monster shader, a VFX kind) breaks a hard budget. Programs first seen mid-match are compile hitches the player sees.
improvements.how: Dump the program list with _harness/prog_owners.mjs at the peak frame. Many are MeshStandardMaterial permutations (skinned and static, shadow and no-shadow, instanced, named per-asset materials like glass_belfry_stone, ironstone, dialwren_matte). Fold the per-asset standard materials into the existing uber.ts/world_material.ts path with shared defines, and unify shadow-depth variants. Target ≤ 34 programs on High with 0 late programs. Re-run perf_1080 --prod and probe_ctxloss.
improvements.risk: Visual drift on merged materials. Gate with value_probe and an A/B shot set.

improvements.what: Ship GPU-compressed textures (KTX2/Basis) to cut VRAM and add a real low-end memory target
improvements.why: Every model texture is WebP (for example ardit.glb uses EXT_texture_webp, 905 .webp assets). WebP decodes to full RGBA8 in GPU memory. RIFT peaks at 2792 MB with 208 MB margin. The 3000 MB bar was set on a 16 GB+ Apple M5. Web-portal players on 8 GB Windows laptops with shared-memory iGPUs are where browser tabs get killed or contexts lost. The Low tier does not reduce texture memory.
improvements.how: Add a KTX2 (UASTC for normals, ETC1S for albedo/ORM) export step in the content build using gltf-transform, which is already a dependency (its ktx-software CLI needs owner approval to install, otherwise use the basis encoder from node_modules/three/examples). Load with KTX2Loader and the transcoder that three ships, with a WebP fallback. Add a Low-tier max texture size of 1024. Gate: RIFT match memory ≤ 2200 MB High and ≤ 1600 MB Low, measured by probe_match_memory.
improvements.risk: Quality loss on fighter albedo. Verify against shot_fighter A/B and the ruling-32 hue checks. Asset download size may change in either direction, so measure both.

improvements.what: Gate unplayable devices before the download: no WebGL2, touch-only and small screens
improvements.why: If createRenderer throws, boot only warns (main.ts:77) and mounts the full menu with renderer null. The player can queue into a match that draws nothing. The string 'state.error.webgl' exists (strings.en.json:174) but no code uses it. Input ignores touch (controller.ts:534 accepts only mouse pointers), so a phone that follows a shared link loads 5.8 MB, reaches Home, and cannot play.
improvements.how: In boot/main.ts, before mount: if the renderer is null, or matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)') matches without '(any-pointer: fine)', or the viewport is under 1024×600, show a branded plate. Use state.error.webgl for no WebGL2, and a new string for touch: 'VALE plays on a computer with a mouse and keyboard', with a 'try anyway' link for hybrids. Add a sweep_720 case with a touch-emulated viewport and an e2e case with ?render=0.
improvements.risk: Hybrid touch laptops. Keep the 'try anyway' escape.

improvements.what: Stop a second tab from wiping wallet, skins and history, and tell the player when progress cannot be saved
improvements.why: LocalProfileStore.save writes the whole profile blob (profile_store.ts:262-268), and src has no 'storage' event listener, BroadcastChannel or navigator.locks (grep). If two tabs are open, the second save overwrites purchases, unlocks and match history from the first. When storage throws (quota or blocked), the store silently sets degraded = true and runs from memory, and no UI reads that flag (grep). All progress is then lost on reload without warning.
improvements.how: Listen for 'storage' on vale.profile.v1. On change, reload and reconcile in memory and refuse stale writes using a monotonic rev field in the blob. Or hold a navigator.locks 'vale-profile' lock and show 'VALE is open in another tab' in the second tab. Show a one-time toast when degraded becomes true. Add a session probe that simulates two stores on one StorageLike.
improvements.risk: Low; covered by probe_session_flows plus a new probe.

improvements.what: Make a throwing sim or renderer recoverable instead of a silent frozen match
improvements.why: The frame loop catches pump and render errors and logs them every frame (app.tsx:211-213). If m.pump throws each tick, the match freezes while the HUD stays up and the console fills at 60 lines/s. The player gets no message, no result, and no way out except Esc to leave. Nothing reports the error.
improvements.how: Count consecutive failures. After 30 pump failures, end the match as 'interrupted' (no rating change), save history, route to Home with a toast, and send the TECH-02 error event. After 30 render failures, show the ViewPlate 'lost' state and try one renderer re-setup. Add an e2e fault-injection hook (dev only) that throws in pump at t=60 s.
improvements.risk: None if the hook is dev-only.

improvements.what: Test Safari (WebKit) and Firefox, and run the determinism digest across JS engines
improvements.why: Every harness, perf gate and e2e drives Google Chrome only. Safari was used only to check audio decode (final/audio.json). On a Mac, Safari's WebGL2 (and on Windows, D3D11 ANGLE) has different limits, shader compile behaviour and context-loss policy. probe_sim_determinism runs only on Node V8. dmath.ts exists because V8 and JSC trig differ, but no test proves digests match across engines. Online lockstep and any future replays depend on that.
improvements.how: Use the built-in safaridriver (no download) with a small WebDriver script to run e2e 'all' plus a 120 s bench in Safari, and capture console errors, programs, fps and memory. Bundle the determinism probe for the browser (vite build of the probe entry), run it in Chrome and Safari, and assert equal digests at ticks 900, 9000 and 27000. Firefox only if the owner installs it. Report the findings; do not fix renderer issues in this lane.
improvements.risk: Safari automation needs 'Allow Remote Automation' turned on in Safari's Develop menu. That is a setting change, so ask the owner.

improvements.what: Measure load on a real network and trim the Home critical path
improvements.why: All load timings came from a local server (ux notes: queue to HUD 19.8-20.9 s, of which loading is 3.1 s). A match needs about 55 MB over 250 requests. At 25 Mbps that is about 18 s of transfer, so on a real line the loading screen may run past the ~9 s draft prefetch window. The Home path carries a 1.7 MB sky.hdr plus a .cube grade before the menu shows anything 3D.
improvements.how: Add a --net cable|4g mode to ux_run/perf (CDP Network.emulateNetworkConditions, 25/5 Mbps, 40-150 ms RTT) against the live CDN URL with a cold profile. Report Home, draft, loading and HUD times. Then: convert sky.hdr to a half-float KTX2 or RGBM WebP (target ≤ 400 KB), check that glass_belfry.glb (1.74 MB) is gzip-served, and make sure the loading screen streams the local seat first.
improvements.risk: None (measurement). The asset changes go through the art lanes.

improvements.what: Turn the browser probes into a standing pre-ship gate, and make package_deploy refuse a red tree
improvements.why: npm run check covers secrets, typecheck, content and the 57 node probes (run_probes.ts:67 runs only probe_*.ts). Browser probes (e2e.mjs, probe_ctxloss, probe_match_memory, overlay_regress, perf_1080, value_probe) are run by hand when a lane remembers them. The repo has no CI. Context loss was last proven on 2026-10-29, and max2 shipped from a tree where probe and value_probe were red.
improvements.how: Add npm run check:browser, which queues e2e all, probe_ctxloss, overlay_regress and perf_1080 --prod counts through heavy.py and writes _harness/_reports/gate_<HEAD>.json. In tools/package_deploy.ts, refuse to stage unless gate_<HEAD>.json exists, is green, and matches the working tree hash (with an --override reason flag that is logged).
improvements.risk: Packaging gets slower. The override keeps emergencies possible.

improvements.what: Low-end scaling: profile a 4× CPU-throttled client and give Low a real geometry and CPU budget
improvements.why: Low is measured only in the menu (65k tris, 27 programs) and in a fixed bench (60 fps on an M5). A Low match peak has never been measured, and the triangle governor is tuned to the High budget. Real low-end players are CPU-bound (bots, sim, HUD Preact and three's matrix updates), and dynres cannot help when the CPU is late (quality.ts header). The pump-plus-render cost on a 2019 i5-class CPU is unknown.
improvements.how: Run perf_1080 with CDP Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate 4 on Low and High for a RIFT late-game teamfight, through heavy.py. Capture cpu_profile.mjs flame data. Set a Low budget (for example ≤ 300k tris, ≤ 250 draws, renderer CPU ≤ 8 ms at 4×) and implement it: crowd and clutter density, LOD bias, ambient and particles off. Make calibration (app.tsx:182-199) also measure CPU and pick Low when the CPU is late.
improvements.risk: Low must keep competitive information identical (quality.ts header rule). Verify telegraphs and fog per tier.

improvements.what: Restore a triangle margin of at least 30k on the worst seed and log what is on screen at the peak
improvements.why: Seed 23 reached 483k of 500k at the peak frame (vfx 40k, actors 250k). Every new fighter LOD, skin or VFX eats a 17k margin. In a crowded frame the governor already drops shadows and flashes, which the player sees as a fight that suddenly looks flatter.
improvements.how: Use the TECH-04 multi-mode data. Log a per-actor triangle breakdown at the peak frame (the renderer already counts per category). Lower the LOD1 switch distance for fighters beyond the nearest 4, or reduce the highest-poly fighter LOD0 by 10 %, until max ≤ 470k on every gated case. Re-run shot_fight A/B.
improvements.risk: Silhouette loss at mid zoom. Check the units lane's sheets.

improvements.what: Split the three code hot spots before the next feature waves
improvements.why: src/audio/index.ts has 2974 lines, render/terrain.ts 2436, actors.ts 1829 and renderer.ts 1585 (8.8k lines in four files). Most lanes this month touched renderer.ts or audio/index.ts, and parallel lanes collide there. The other big files are under 1.5k lines. Untracked _harness/_tmp_* diagnostics are piling up too.
improvements.how: Split by seam with no behaviour change. audio becomes bus/mix, cue scheduler, music, ambience and listener. terrain becomes build, props, landmarks and textures. renderer moves match setup and teardown, ctx-loss and preload into their own modules. Keep public exports. Prove no change with typecheck, all probes, perf_1080 counts identical, and the e2e console clean. Move _harness/_tmp_* into _harness/_scratch or delete them once their lanes close.
improvements.risk: Merge pain with live lanes. Do it in a quiet window and one file per commit.

notes: Read-only checks only; no heavy runs. CDN behaviour verified with curl against the live worker on 2026-11-15 (cache-control headers, If-None-Match returning 200). Portal checked with curl. Code claims cite file:line at HEAD f3ee3a036. Evidence used: orch1/idle_gates.json, orch1/evidence/ux/notes.md and HUD shots, orch1/evidence/visual/sheet_quality_teamfight.png, final/perf.json, closing2/client.json, max2/critic.json. No game code or assets changed.
